description: AGP - Above Ground Pipes - Open is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. We have pipes that sit above ground that may cross a land feature whether that be rivers, bridges or ravine. This dataset shows the locations of such pipes. This Data Asset shows these pipes owned by Cadent Gas Limited in its role as a Licensed Gas Transporter (GT). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Asset, Open. Its keywords are Gas crossing, Above Ground Pipes, Gas Pipes, Gas River Crossing. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
